optimizedDescription.value: Abstract GraphStore port defining atomic persistence, queries, search ranking, freshness tracking, generation semantics, and lifecycle rules.

optimizedContext.value:
# Graph Store

## Rules

- `GraphStore`: abstract class port; ctor `storagePath`; defined `domain/ports/`, adapters `infrastructure/`; implementations own physical schema/layout.
- Min semantics: `FileNode` (canonical path, `configRelativePath`, full content), `SymbolNode`, `SpecNode`, `DocumentNode`; store metadata `lastIndexedAt`, `lastIndexedRef`, persisted graph fingerprint.
- Relations: `IMPORTS`, `DEFINES`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXPORTS`, `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`. `COVERS_SYMBOL` MAY carry `metadata.stale`.
- Lifecycle: `open()` prepares backend; `close()` idempotent/repeat-safe; ops throw `StoreNotOpenError` when not open.
- `recreate()`: destructive backend reset, rotates generation marker (e.g. `graph/storage.epoch`); provider/indexer owns reset — callers MUST NOT delete backend files. Incompatible schema → reject reads, no silent empty graph; repair = destructive rebuild + rotate generation + rebuild search indexes.
- Mutations (atomic per file/spec): `upsertFile(file, symbols, relations)`, `addRelations(relations)` (additive, cross-file), `removeFile(filePath)`, `upsertSpec(spec, relations)`, `removeSpec(specId)`.
- Queries: `getFile`, `findFilesByConfigRelativePath`, `getSymbol`, `getCallers`, `getCallees`, `getImporters`, `getImportees`, `getExtenders`, `getExtendedTargets`, `getImplementors`, `getImplementedTargets`, `getOverriders`, `getOverriddenTargets`, `getSpec`, `getSpecDependencies`, `getSpecDependents`, `getCoveredFiles`, `getCoveredSymbols`, `getCoveringSpecsForFile`, `getCoveringSpecsForSymbol`, `findSymbols(SymbolQuery)`, `getStatistics(): GraphStatistics`.
- `SymbolQuery`: `name` (glob/regex), `kinds[]`, `filePath`, `comment` (substring), `caseSensitive` (default false).
- `getStatistics()`: `fileCount`, `symbolCount`, `specCount`, `relationCounts: Record<RelationType, number>`, `languages`, `lastIndexedAt` (ISO 8601, read-only), `lastIndexedRef`, `graphFingerprint`.
- Bulk: `clear()`, `getAllFiles()`, `getAllSpecs()`.
- Search: `searchSymbols`, `searchSpecs`, `searchDocuments` — ranked relevance descending; `rebuildFtsIndexes()`; snippets + 1-based `startLine`/`endLine`.
- Lexical expansion: preserve normalized token; split whitespace, `:`, `/`, `_`, `.`, `-`, CamelCase/PascalCase.
- Ranking order: exact canonical identity > exact primary/alternate identity > identity prefix/suffix/substring token > structured component/path-component > generic text (BM25). Token strength: `x` > `x%` > `%x` > `%x%`; component match (`core` in `core:change`) > arbitrary substring (`core` in `score`); higher identity-token coverage ranks higher. Generic text always remains in retrieval.
- `SearchOptions`: `query` (required), `limit` (default 20), `kind`, `filePattern` (glob, case-insensitive), `workspace`, `excludePaths`, `excludeWorkspaces`; filters applied before `limit`.
- Reference/coverage: atomically persist logical-symbol identity, bindings/provenance, per-file/package coverage; never parse/case-fold serialized canonical ids for selectors/ranking; deterministic batch queries, no scan per reference; one complete reference-fact snapshot + one batched direct-affected-file query; reverse coverage batch query returns `COVERS_FILE`/`COVERS_SYMBOL` in deterministic source/type/target order; empty batch → empty result.
- Source-content candidates: persist symbol construct/selection ranges; backend-neutral candidate query over `FileNode.content`; substring index for ≥3 chars, bounded fallback for shorter; never return all files for ordinary search; candidates only — merging/ranking/suppression belong to app layer.
- Freshness: persist `IndexedInputObservation` (workspace, resource kind/id, input kind, locator, content hash, mtime/size/revision, monotonic stale flag); files/docs → 1 observation, aggregate specs → all inputs; batch compare-and-set marks stale/refreshes equal content, atomically updates workspace + aggregate latches; one monotonic `knownStaleSinceLastIndex` latch per workspace + one aggregate; cleared only by successful index; transient unknown assessments never persisted stale.
- Bulk session: begins once, accepts bounded chunks, commits once, rebuilds search indexes once post-commit; batch relation validation/hierarchy lookups (no Store call per relation); dedupe equivalent relations; failed session never exposes partial generation.

## Constraints

- Abstract class, not interface.
- All mutations atomic at file level; throw `StoreNotOpenError` when closed.
- `recreate()` owned by provider/indexer, not caller file deletion.
- No prescribed backend/schema/layout; storage-agnostic consumers rely on abstract semantics.
- No `@specd/core` dependency; errors extend `CodeGraphError`.
